title: Add subscription-paddle, a Paddle Billing provider plugin
detail: Checkout via the Paddle.js overlay on a page served by the feature at /billing/paddle-checkout. The Default Payment Link in the Paddle dashboard must point to <APP_BASE_URL>/billing/paddle-checkout; it is the only source, because transactions are created without a checkout url. Create subscription prices in the Paddle catalog with quantity minimum and maximum 1; for one-off packs set the quantity limits on purpose, because the payment event carries quantity and the app has to multiply its credits by it. Also ships customer portal, cancel, resume, batched price lookup, in-app plan switch and tenant binding of checkouts through an HMAC in custom_data.

title: Remove subscription-dodo, replaced by subscription-paddle
detail: Removed exports of @cosmicdrift/kumiko-bundled-features/subscription-dodo: DODO_BASE_URLS, DODO_PROVIDER_NAME, DodoEnvironment, DodoEnvironments, SUBSCRIPTION_DODO_FEATURE, SubscriptionDodoOptions, createSubscriptionDodoFeature, dodoEnvSchema, subscriptionDodoEnvSchema.
migration: Replace createSubscriptionDodoFeature with createSubscriptionPaddleFeature from @cosmicdrift/kumiko-bundled-features/subscription-paddle and dodoEnvSchema with paddleEnvSchema. Map Paddle price ids (pri_...) to tiers in priceToTier, set PADDLE_API_KEY, PADDLE_WEBHOOK_SECRET, PADDLE_TENANT_BINDING_KEY and PADDLE_CLIENT_TOKEN (or the matching config keys) and point the Default Payment Link at /billing/paddle-checkout. Point the Paddle notification destination at /webhooks/subscription/paddle when billing is mounted through the server-runtime boot option (SUBSCRIPTION_WEBHOOK_PATH), or at /api/subscription/webhook/paddle when createSubscriptionWebhookRoute is mounted by hand. In server-runtime boot options, billing.dodo becomes billing.paddle. An app-own credit-pack env such as DODO_PRODUCT_PACKS becomes a list of Paddle pri_ ids; the pack size comes from the price or product custom_data.credits, which surfaces as ProviderPrice.metadata.credits. Existing Dodo subscriptions are not migrated; a subscription stays with the provider stored on it.
